verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor, a hardware product. Versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy is a software/service axis that buyers comparing CPUs would not reasonably ask about. The evidence mentions related Intel toolkits (oneAPI, OpenVINO), but none of it shows the processor itself ships versioned APIs or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all paths, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
